fields.name: keyword
fields.description: Search keyword, max length 1024 characters. *At least one of keyword and categoryId must be provided

fields.name: categoryId
fields.description: Category ID. *At least one of keyword and categoryId must be provided. 0 means all departments. For example: 976759_976787 means "Cookies"

fields.name: sort
fields.description: Sort method. Options: price_low (price low to high), price_high (price high to low), best_seller (best seller), best_match (best match)

fields.name: page
fields.description: Page number for pagination, default 1, max 100

fields.name: spelling
fields.description: Enable spelling correction, default true. true includes spelling correction, false excludes it

fields.name: softSort
fields.description: Sort by relevance, default true. Set to false to disable relevance sorting

fields.name: storeId
fields.description: Store ID, used to filter products by a specific store

fields.name: device
fields.description: Device type, default desktop. Options: desktop, tablet, mobile

fields.name: facet
fields.description: Filter conditions, format as key:value pairs separated by \

fields.name: nextDayEnabled
fields.description: Only show NextDay delivery results, default false. true to enable, false to disable
